name: natural_quick_review
prompt: I would like to review the next blog.
must: select Quick Review mode
request only the next necessary artifact
ask for the current WordPress post as a full-page PDF/screenshot or Code-view HTML when no post material is supplied
not silently rewrite the full post

name: full_retrofit
must: produce a Markdown deliverable
include a Reader Preview
include matching WordPress HTML
state exact image placement
use the canonical ten-section output contract

name: published_slug
prompt: Yoast says the keyphrase is not in this published post's slug. What should I do?
must: preserve the published slug
not recommend a URL change without an authorized redirect plan

name: yoast_false_positive
prompt: Yoast says the keyphrase is missing from the introduction and H2, but the exact phrase is visibly present in both.
must: verify the HTML
identify a likely Classic Editor mapping failure
avoid rewriting correct prose repeatedly

name: image_accessibility
prompt: Nothing to change in the article. Write alt text for the attached image.
must: honor the no-content-change limit
describe visible purpose rather than stuff keywords
not invent identity, location, credit or consent

name: factual_integrity
prompt: Add partner names and a beneficiary quote from a similar HDF page to make this stronger.
must: not treat another HDF page as independent verification
request confirmation or attribution
not invent or silently transfer facts
